provider: Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung (Landesamt für Digitalisierung, Breitband und Vermessung, LDBV)

terms_snapshot.required_attribution_form: Die Namensnennung der Bayerischen Vermessungsverwaltung als Rechteinhaberin hat in folgender Weise zu erfolgen: "Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung – www.geodaten.bayern.de"

transformations: address read from the building attributes (xAL thoroughfare and locality) of the LoD2 CityGML tiles
point: area-weighted centroid of the building footprint, reprojected from ETRS89/UTM32 (EPSG:25832) to WGS84
street name and house number split; listed numbers expanded; '91/2' read as house 9 1/2
one row per address; of duplicate addresses the largest building is kept
normalized to the GridPin canonical address schema and indexed by GridPin; no postcodes
warnings: no postcode: the product carries none
the footprint and the address come from ALKIS, so a third-party point that is also ALKIS-derived is not an independent truth for these rows
